title: Baby shower cake near Schofields or Marsden Park? 100% eggless, from Riverstone
summary:
Baby shower cake near Schofields or Marsden Park, and half the guest list is vegetarian? Every custom cake at our Riverstone store is 100% eggless. Nobody has to ask what's in it.

A 10-inch serves 20-22 and starts at $39.99 for a 6-inch, $74.99 for the 10-inch. Gender reveal colours, a name in buttercream, a photo reference from your Pinterest board: send it, and we recreate it.

Order with 48 hours notice. Pickup from Shop 8, Riverstone Shopping Centre, with free parking at the door. Which is why a pram and a cake box can share the same trip.

No eggs were harmed. No flavour was sacrificed. 🎂
